log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed all 11 in free blocks (morning/afternoon). Watch pool size in press conferences; caught if pool <=1000.

Day1: killed 10 in free blocks (morning/afternoon), pool 100k->40k after 3 traces. Day2: killed 9 (national + most), skipped d2-4 and d2-10, all quick in morning/afternoon. Keep kills at ~6-10/day for the multiplier (30 deaths in 5 days) but watch the pool; caught if pool <=1000. Never use evening/night blocks (I am busy then).

Day1: 10 kills, pool 100k->40k. Day2: 9 kills, pool 9k. Day3: pool shrinking fast, so I cut to 2 kills (national d3-9 plus one regional:South d3-6), all quick, morning/afternoon only. Never use evening/night blocks (I am busy then). Caught if pool <=1000, which costs half my points. Priorities: kill national-only criminals, since they give L nothing. Watch the pool and traced count each day. Consider pausing kills entirely if the pool nears 3000. The multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days, which is likely unreachable safely, so don't chase it.

Don't chase the multiplier.
